structuralFindings: Currency is EUR, not USD — confirmed from document header 'All rates are in EUROS per person per night on All Inclusive basis'.
Base meal plan is All Inclusive (AI) — there is no separate Half Board/Full Board base tier documented here, unlike Soroi's Ground Package model or Soroi Blue's Half Board base.
Five room categories: Garden Room, Sea Facing Room, Superior Room/Family Room (shown as one combined column), Deluxe Room, Suite Room.
Each room category has three price points per season: PPS (per person sharing double), SR (single room rate), and 3rd Adult rate — not a flat per-person figure.
No mandatory conservancy/park fee structure exists (expected for a beach resort, consistent with Soroi Blue's finding).
Minimum stay of 5 nights applies to the 22 Dec-03 Jan festive window specifically; not stated as a minimum for other seasons on this page.

Children policy: 0-<2yrs free sharing with 2 adults; 2-11.99yrs sharing with 2 adults = 50% of PPS rate; 1 adult + 1 child sharing = adult pays SR, child pays 50% of PPS; 2-3 children in own room = 75% of PPS each.

Check-in 1300hrs / check-out 1000hrs; early arrival/late departure outside these times charged EUR 30/person (facilities only, no room); Dayroom with room use = 75% of PPS or SR rate, latest checkout 1700hrs.
